title: Extract additional compressed tilemaps
changes: Extend the observed tilemap resource with seven authenticated mode-4 streams, preserving ascending, repeated and literal tokens and leaving inter-stream padding to the original routing.
validation: Wine decoder e198-tilemap-source-nuq8mgl_ and source audit e198-streams-source-2llwimo3 establish seven encoded extents and decoded hashes. Wine e198-streams-wine-d97f6l58 verifies preservation, malformed/coherent edit rejection, altered source and mixed boundaries, and all 1792 original interpreter/native cell results with equal complete state and guest clock per stream.
Wine e198-streams-cli-wine-gfc_c1yi creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: The reader log contains a D-Bus pending-call assertion before successful completion; the Wine host defect is tracked separately. Ordinary use, other consumers and tilemaps, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements were performed.
